opportunities.title: Poetry
opportunities.length_limits: 2–6 poems, up to 10 pages total.
opportunities.formatting: Submit poems as a single document. Preferred file types are doc, docx, rtf, txt, or wpf; PDFs may also be uploaded with one of those file types.
opportunities.eligibility: Previously unpublished work only. Poems in all languages are welcome; for poems not primarily in English, include a translation of the non-English portions. Only human-written poetry and prose are published.

evidence.excerpt: Submit to Poetry
Guidelines for Poetry
Submitting to Poetry is free.
Please follow the guidelines below to submit 2–6 poems (up to 10 pages total).

Save your poems as a single document. We prefer doc, docx, rtf, txt, or wpf files as they work better for us if work is accepted. If you prefer to upload a pdf to ensure formatting is preserved, please also upload your poems as one of the other file types.
We welcome poems in all languages.
We only publish human-written poetry and prose.
Our current rate is $500 per poem.
Poetry is open to simultaneous submissions, but let us know immediately if work is accepted elsewhere by adding a message to your submission specifying the work that is no longer available.

We consider only previously unpublished work. Writing that has appeared online for any reason, including social media posts, is considered to have been previously published and should not be submitted.

opportunities.title: Translation
opportunities.length_limits: No more than 7 poems, for a total of 15 pages maximum, including the originals.
opportunities.formatting: Include both the original poem and the translation.
opportunities.eligibility: Previously unpublished translations only. Translations into English of poems originally composed in all languages are welcome. Only human-written poetry and prose are published.
opportunities.payment: Payment will be $250 flat rate for accepted translations. The translator is paid for the translation, and the original author or rights holder is paid for the originals.
opportunities.simultaneous_submissions: Open to simultaneous submissions; notify Poetry immediately if work is accepted elsewhere.
opportunities.reprints: Previously unpublished translations only. Translations that have appeared online for any reason, including social media posts, are considered previously published.

evidence.excerpt: Submit to Translation
Guidelines for Translation
Submitting to Poetry is free.
For translations, please submit no more than 7 poems, for a total of 15 pages maximum (including the originals).
Please include both the original poem and your translation.
We consider only previously unpublished translations.
We welcome translations into English of poems originally composed in all languages.

For translations, we pay the translator for the translation, and the original author or rights holder for the originals. For accepted translations, we will request a one-page translator's note. We will give you guidance for what to include. Payment will be $250 flat rate.
Poetry is open to simultaneous submissions, but let us know immediately if work is accepted elsewhere by adding a message to your submission specifying the work that is no longer available.
Translations that have appeared online for any reason, including social media posts, are considered to have been previously published and should not be submitted.

evidence.excerpt: Submit to Prose (essays about poetry - but not poems, prose poems, or fiction)
Guidelines for Prose (essays about poetry - but not poems, prose poems, or fiction)
We close for submissions annually from June 15 through September 15.
Submitting to Poetry is free.

Our typical essay length is about 1,500 - 2,500 words. As a maximum, please submit no more than ten pages; if the work is longer than that, please note that in the cover letter and we will ask to see more if we are interested.
Please send only one submission at a time per category, and wait until you hear back from us before uploading a new submission.
Poetry magazine welcomes personal and idiosyncratic prose pertaining to poets and poetry.
This is not a form for straightforward literary criticism or academic prose.
Essays that explore unique or unexpected connections between poetry and the wider culture (pop culture, politics, internet culture, art, etc.).
Roundtable discussions or conversations between a group of poets on a specific topic related to poetry or the craft of poetry.
Our current rate is $400 per published page in print for prose.
Poetry is open to simultaneous submissions, but let us know immediately if work is accepted elsewhere by adding a message to your submission specifying the work that is no longer available.

We consider only previously unpublished work. Writing that has appeared online for any reason, including social media posts, is considered to have been previously published and should not be submitted.
